Proposition

1. ch3:3.21If $F:M\to N$ is smooth, then $dF:TM\to TN$ is smooth.

Proof

\sketch In natural coordinates, (3.9) gives

\[ dF(x,v)= \left(F(x), \left(\frac{\partial F^\alpha }{\partial x^i}(x)v^i\right)_\alpha \right). \]

This map is smooth because the coordinate functions of $F$ and their first partial derivatives are smooth.

□
